pairs.why: The two wagons are almost the same; B's dirt road is smoother and less cluttered with pebbles and flowers, which is the direction the texture lessons favor.
This is the mirror of q000: A has the smoother, less busy ground, while B adds scattered pebbles and flower texture.

A buries the windmill in a dense, stalk-by-stalk wheat field and adds bolt detail, which is the over-textured look the lessons reject; B's soft painted field is closer to the smooth finish of the real cards.
This is the mirror of q002: A has the smooth golden field, while B has the busy, over-detailed wheat texture.
The fire, stones and lighting are rendered identically in both; the only difference is that A adds a cabin and a kettle, which changes the props but not the style.
This is the mirror of q004: the rendering is the same, and only the extra cabin and kettle in B differ.
